note: Content ID block-list approved by BiBi. (1) Big-label songs (WMG/Warner, Sony/SME, UMG/Universal, T-Series and similar) are skipped unless the song is one of BiBi's priority songs (priority=high). (2) A song that already got a Content ID claim is never used again, priority or not. Matched on artist / title / credit / label / channel / uploader / source_url. Checked by music_lib.is_denied_track, so the picker, the credits.json fallback, ingest and the box music restore all obey it.
